fixture_scripts_freeze.command: node evals/skill-onoff/freeze-pack.js --id fixture-scripts-g67 --scripts scripts/repo-residue-sweep.js,scripts/pin-evidence-anchors.js,scripts/reap-dispatch-branches.sh,scripts/lib/json-emit.sh,scripts/lib/worktree-reap.sh --ref <merged develop sha containing close-session AND the guidance-v7 merge>
fixture_scripts_freeze.why_explicit_list: repo-residue-sweep.js spawns scripts/pin-evidence-anchors.js via path.join(__dirname, ...) and finish-flow runs reap-dispatch-branches.sh (+ the two shell libs it sources); freeze-pack follows only literal relative JS requires, so these are named explicitly. Verified 2026-10-10 against release-3.0.0 @ 29938656: 13 files, close-session exits 0 on the g7-close fixture.
fixture_scripts_freeze.installed_twice: in the manifest fixture_scripts (copied onto the fixture repo root, after fixture-scripts-sg) AND in the manifest files list (copied to the synthetic PLUGIN root). The second is load-bearing: finish-flow derives autopilot_root from the plugin root and its resolver requires scripts/reap-dispatch-branches.sh there; without it the G7 row cannot even resolve its script path in the eval plugin
fixture_scripts_freeze.same_in_both_arms: both arm manifests list the pack in both places: the OFF arm HAS the close-session sweep too, so the only variable is the guidance text

ship_rule: SHIP iff EVERY task has ON passing >= on_min_reps of 3 reps AND OFF passing <= off_max_reps of 3 reps
stop_rule: any (task,arm,rep) cell with no clean row (infra_fail or missing) => STOP; rerun that cell (run-g67-campaign.js resumes, max 3 attempts per cell), never score around it
invalid_rule: mixed models, mixed runner versions, a runner version other than runner_version_pin, more than one arm manifest per arm, identical off/on manifests, a registered manifest sha not matched, or the manipulation check (task skill invoked in < 90% of an arm's cells) => INSTRUMENT-INVALID
timeout_semantics: per-cell timeout is the registered stop, not a failure: ONOFF_TIMEOUT_IS_COMPLETE=1 makes exit 124/137 with a non-empty transcript a complete cell (row carries stopped_by_timeout:true). A cell that has not issued the registered call by the timeout scores false for its arm.
scope_lock: authorises ONLY: sonnet depth-0, headless -p, runner 2.1.292, these four briefs, the frozen off/on arm manifests. Says nothing about foreman/hands behaviour after entry, opus/fable, or interactive sessions.

markers.g6_size: the FIRST `session-mode.js set` Bash invocation carrying the task's level (--level lN, or --entry-level lN) also carries --size <XS|S|M|L|XL> (literal)
markers.g7_close: ANY Bash invocation of `repo-residue-sweep.js close-session` carrying --session <non-empty: literal sid or $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID> and --yes
